listingHero.description: Discover the most celebrated landmarks, historic temples, sun-kissed coasts, and scenic backwaters that make Mangalore a world-renowned destination.

listingCatalog.title: Famous Tourist Places in
listingCatalog.description: Explore the most famous and must-visit attractions in and around Mangalore with practical travel timings, location info, and visitor ratings.

places.name: Panambur Beach
places.description: Mangalore's most visited beach with pristine golden sand, safe swimming zones, water sports, and magnificent twilight sunsets.

places.name: Kudroli Gokarnanatha Temple
places.description: World-famous spiritual landmark consecrated by Sri Narayana Guru, renowned for its glittering gold gopuram and grand Mangalore Dasara.

places.name: Kadri Manjunath Temple
places.description: Historic 10th-century shrine atop Kadri hill featuring ancient bronze Lokeshwara statue and natural mountain spring water ponds.

places.name: Tannirbhavi Beach & Tree Park
places.description: Tranquil shoreline bordered by lush coastal pine woods, reached by scenic Gurupura river boat ferry or coastal road.

places.name: Sultan Battery Watchtower
places.description: Black stone mini-fortress built by Tipu Sultan in 1784 guarding the river mouth, offering sweeping panoramic backwater vistas.

places.name: Pilikula Nisargadhama
places.description: Premier eco-tourism sanctuary encompassing a biological wildlife safari, artisan heritage village, planetarium, and botanical gardens.

places.name: Someshwar Beach & Rudra Shila
places.description: Dramatic coastal seascape marked by massive ancient black rocks called Rudra Shila overlooking crashing Arabian Sea waves.

places.name: Light House Hill & Tagor Park
places.description: 18th-century maritime lighthouse on a panoramic ridge offering sea breezes, shaded garden trails, and bird-eye harbor outlooks.
